description: Majority Leader Bell offered the following statement: “firefighting is a particularly hazardous occupation where those employed in this industry are drastically more likely to be affected by a wide variety of health issues, both during their career and long after they retire. While I pray that the day never comes where a firefighter hears they have cancer, this bill will ensure that they are taken care of and looked after.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: Bill Filed to Protect Firefighters Diagnosed with Cancer
